name: DS · system, old 03 · Send with keyboard
title: Send

catalogue.note: A 1.0 partial screen, redrawn small for the folio. 272 wide in Figma is 375 real: factor 0.72533, the scaleFactor the keyboard instance in this section carries (its 241, 42 and 8 land whole). Every value is the Figma value divided by 0.72533, so hand-set numbers do not land whole: type 10 → 13.79, 40-high field → 55.15; 5.76 and 11.52 are 8 and 16 at 0.72. The same pieces inside the full-dress screens are another drawing (0.7389, 327 wide, 64-high field, regular 23px “501”), so the two do not agree and neither was changed. The card’s own 8px corners are left off; the frame is 757 high, the last fraction of a pixel is white. The coloured highlight boxes over the screen are not drawn: their rectangles are in meta.json under “highlights”, in this screen’s real pixels. The keyboard and toolbar are the Android library instances (digits in Roboto 400, icons from Figma’s export); the bottom bar under them is 277 wide in a 272 frame and overhangs both sides. The top block starts 7.7 above the frame and the keyboard covers the lower half of the swipe button: as in the file. The naira sign is not in Satoshi (the files on this Mac hold 431 glyphs, none of them U+20A6) and Figma draws it from a fallback face, the same outline at every weight: it is Figma’s own outline of the glyph, inline, 0.572em wide. The SF Pro Display symbols (chevrons, info, close, arrow) are Figma’s outlines of those text nodes; SF Pro is not among the project fonts. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own small scale, so some lines sit up to 1px lower in Figma than in a browser; they are left where the browser puts them. Edges that fall on fractions of a pixel are blurred over two rows by Figma and snapped to one by Chrome. Flat fills match exactly.
